App details

Meal Planner — „Mit főzzek?”

Find ideas for what to cook, use ingredients and leftovers, and plan your week.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Reduce the daily effort of deciding what to cook. Get up to three recipe suggestions based on your choices or ingredients at home, or use a separate option for prepared leftovers. Plan one recipe per day for seven days, keep the days you like and change others. The recipe selection and ingredient recognition are still being checked.

Main features

  • Up to three suitable recipe suggestions.
  • Separate options for ingredients and prepared leftovers.
  • Seven-day plan with one chosen recipe per day.
  • Own recipes, preferences and a combined shopping list.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Choose preferences or enter ingredients at home to receive up to three suitable recipe ideas. Prepared leftovers have a separate input and only validated uses are suggested. Build a seven-day plan with one chosen recipe each day; keep selected days and replace the rest. Save your own recipes, mark cooked dishes, and combine required ingredients into a shopping list. Confirm any camera recognition before use.

Important limits

Recipe content, ingredient matches and substitutions still need validation. There is no allergen-free guarantee, medical diet advice or automatic leftover safety assessment. The weekly plan has one recipe per day, not breakfast, lunch and dinner slots.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Camera permission is requested only for recognition; chosen photos use Photo Picker or files. Manual ingredient and leftover entry remain available without camera.

Local data

Own recipes, preferences, ingredients, leftovers, plans, shopping lists and cooking notes would be local. Camera recognition is intended on-device. No required account or server-side AI is planned.

Advertising and purchases

Manual ingredients and basic planning remain free. Free camera recognition allows three scans in any rolling 24 hours, shared by visual recognition, text reading and barcodes. One-time Premium removes ads and the scan limit. No subscription is planned.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Planning and manual recipes are included in the proposed first version. AI-generated recipes, unvalidated substitutions and automatic food-safety claims are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
